summary.text: XTANDI (enzalutamide) received regular (full) approval for mCRPC previously treated with docetaxel, based on a statistically significant overall survival benefit in the randomized Phase 3 CRPC2 trial. The NDA was granted priority review (PDUFA 11/22/12) and approved on a first cycle; no advisory committee was convened.

citations.quote: The clinical reviewers recommend regular approval of NDA 203415 that provides for the use of enzalutamide for “the treatment of patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have previously received docetaxel”.
